content: @ShadowVariable(variableListenerClass=..., sourceVariableName=...) plus a class implementing VariableListener<Solution_,Entity_> is the class-based shadow-variable mechanism, already documented in 0.8.x docs (@CustomShadowVariable does not even appear there, confirming @ShadowVariable had already superseded it pre-1.16). @PiggybackShadowVariable, @InverseRelationShadowVariable, @AnchorShadowVariable are companion annotations, same vintage. A newer 'declarative shadow variable' API (@ShadowSources, supplier-based) exists but was still in PREVIEW as of 1.25.0 per GitHub discussion #1837 -- not available/stable at 1.16.0 and not needed for this milestone.
